name: laws-of-ux
description: Audits a frontend project against the 30 Laws of UX (lawsofux.com). Detects the UI stack, fans out concern-area auditor subagents (information architecture, visual hierarchy/Gestalt, interaction & feedback, forms & input), grades each APPLICABLE law from concrete source-code signals, and produces a graded report (0-100 + A-F) with a findings table, a coverage band that states what could not be assessed, and a prioritized quick-wins-vs-larger-efforts fix list. Static by default; an optional --url pass measures the running app with the chrome-devtools MCP. Read-only unless you run /ux-fix.
